Interwoven throughout this rigid structure are repeating geometric patterns, rendered as vibrant, glowing bioluminescent stained glass. These continuous, crystalline lines pulse gently against the backdrop of deep ocean blues and violets, creating a sense of monumental, otherworldly geometry. The entire scene holds a steady, luminous glow, emphasizing the breathtaking detail of the skeletal architecture.
